title: Haaretz: IDF West Bank chief knew of settler entry into Jericho but did not tell officers
detail: A Haaretz-sourced headline published November 6, 2026 reports that the IDF's West Bank commander knew of settlers entering Jericho but did not inform his officers. Only the headline summary was available; details should be checked against the full report.

title: Israel orders deportation of 12 foreign activists detained during West Bank olive harvest
detail: A feed item published November 6, 2026 reports Israel has ordered the deportation of 12 foreign activists detained during the West Bank olive harvest. Only the headline summary was available; details should be checked against the full report.
